coach.name: Travis Bush
coach.title: Head Coach
coach.prior_program: First-time college head coach. Assistant stops: Texas State (WR, then associate HC and co-OC, 2004-09), UTSA (first OC, 2011), Houston (RB, then OC/QBs and assistant HC, 2012-14), Buffalo Bills (offensive assistant, 2015); HC at Seguin HS and New Braunfels Canyon HS.
coach.system_summary: A pass-leaning spread with Air Raid influence (Levine/Meacham at Houston) layered on the Texas State offense he helped run to 4th in FCS scoring in 2008. His best players were volume pass-game producers and accurate, moderately mobile quarterbacks; his documented lows were pocket quarterbacks in year two of a system. 2025 synthesized it: a portal QB (Newcomer of the Year), a freshman WR (Freshman of the Year), a freshman OL All-American, 9-3.

system_pillars.label: Texas State (Bailiff/Wright, 2004–09)
system_pillars.detail: scheme listed as "Multiple," but Bush's own co-OC units ranked 4th in FCS scoring (2008) and 8th in pass offense (2009); the rewarded profile was a big, record-setting WR (Luke) and an efficient multi-year QB (George). https://goutsa.com/staff/travis-bush ; https://txst.com/news/2008/12/17/121708aaa_632

system_pillars.label: UTSA (Coker, 2011)
system_pillars.detail: start-up spread with a sophomore QB who ran and threw (Soza 237/108 in game one); a start-from-scratch blueprint he explicitly cited when taking UTRGV. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2011_UTSA_Roadrunners_football_team ; https://texasfootball.com/article/2023/07/25/bush-sees-similarities-and-differences-between-utsa-and-utrgv

system_pillars.label: Houston (Levine, 2012–14)
system_pillars.detail: tempo spread with Air Raid influence (Meacham co-OC 2013); rewarded high-volume WRs (Greenberry 76 rec) and a freshman QB throwing 28 TD; the 2014 Wildcat/Ward package shows willingness to play a converted athlete at QB. https://uhcougars.com/news/2013/1/14/Doug_Meacham_Named_Houston_Offensive_Coordinator ; https://thedailycougar.com/2014/09/11/insertion-ward-wildcat-package-takes-pressure-okorn/

system_pillars.label: Buffalo (Ryan/Roman/Lynn, 2015)
system_pillars.detail: run-first, two-back "balance in the backfield" with elite broken-tackle backs (McCoy, Williams 5.8 ypc); his one exposure to a power-run NFL system. https://www.pff.com/news/pro-bills-find-balance-in-backfield-with-mccoy-and-williams

system_pillars.label: High school (Seguin/Canyon)
system_pillars.detail: 52-ppg district champion at Seguin and a 3,000-yd/34-TD QB at Canyon who became a P4 signee, consistent with a QB-centric spread. https://n.rivals.com/news/louisville-lands-central-texas-playmaker-qb-deuce-adams

tree_roots: Texas State 2004-10 (Bush, Bowen, Barela, Langford, Regalado)

archetype.title: How you play, your program archetype
archetype.lede: Built from every stop of your career and your position coaches' careers, not from one UTRGV season. Each room below reads the coach's own producers and the recruits they came in as.
archetype.system_profile: Pass-first spread (39.6 ppg in 2025) protected by a developmental line, with a multiple, 3-4-hybrid defense that led the Southland in five categories. Producers across the staff were three-stars and below, Texas-rooted, and arrived from high school, JUCO or as transfers down.

archetype.gaps_summary: Combine and camp testing is almost absent from the public record (one hand-timed 40). Recruiting ratings exist for 38 of 100 rows; the rest are unrated by the services, which is itself part of the archetype. Position coaches new in 2026 (Aych, Jones) and one-season rooms (Henderson, Regalado, Lockhart) are provisional until 2026 results land.
